scope: Administrator foreground notifications only; no external recipient, paid service, Firebase rule or customer form changes

backup.scope: public git source only, not Firebase customer-data export

assertions: initial actual unread/failed counts exclude tests
recovered notification stays unread until acknowledgment
unsaved notification outcome is visible and retryable
repeated retry clicks and concurrent same-request alerts prevented
permission rejection/errors keep request list available
logout stops later notifications and stale messages
first server snapshot read even when cache has identical data
untouched: existing member sync and coupon settings
customer quote form and price settings
remainingLimitations: No notification while the administrator page is closed
OS alert failure/recovery is simulated in DOM tests, not forced on the operating browser
Source restoration drill is not a customer database restore
